attributes.value:
WARNING!

KEEP BATTERIES OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN. BATTERIES ARE HAZARDOUS (NEW OR USED). Batteries can cause serious injuries if swallowed or placed inside any part of the body. attributes.name: Safety Message
attributes.value:
WARNING!

KEEP BATTERIES OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN. BATTERIES ARE HAZARDOUS (NEW OR USED). Batteries can cause serious injuries if swallowed or placed inside any part of the body. Seek medical attention immediately if you suspect a battery has been swallowed or placed inside the body. Dispose of used button/coin batteries immediately and safely. A battery can still be dangerous even when it can no longer operate the device. Place sticky tape around the battery and dispose of it immediately out of reach of children in an outside bin or recycle safely.

Contact the Australian Poisons Information Centre immediately for 24/7 fast, expert advice on 13 11 26.

safetyMessage:
WARNING!

KEEP BATTERIES OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN. BATTERIES ARE HAZARDOUS (NEW OR USED). Batteries can cause serious injuries if swallowed or placed inside any part of the body. Seek medical attention immediately if you suspect a battery has been swallowed or placed inside the body. Dispose of used button/coin batteries immediately and safely. A battery can still be dangerous even when it can no longer operate the device. Place sticky tape around the battery and dispose of it immediately out of reach of children in an outside bin or recycle safely.

Contact the Australian Poisons Information Centre immediately for 24/7 fast, expert advice on 13 11 26.
